title: Salts and Water of Crystallisation
summary: Neutralisation, pH of salts, and common salt, baking soda, washing soda, bleaching powder and plaster of Paris.

ib.note: Acids, bases and salts, MYP 5 Chemistry

objectives: I can name salts from their acid and base.
I can predict whether a salt solution is acidic, basic or neutral.
I can describe the preparation and uses of important salts.
misconceptions: Water of crystallisation makes crystals wet.
